rule_or_requirement: The held-out pixel-only speed policy must be represented by a static-checkable exact local ZIP before any independent package comparison.
observable_information: Frozen control ZIP, frozen student runtime and stable wrapper source, exact safe student checkpoint, package inventory and hashes.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Build a local ZIP that wraps the unchanged full-road-guard control with stable-risk and student runtime, adding only two modules and one safe checkpoint.
expected_success_endpoint: One exact local ZIP with expected input hashes, allowed inventory, no static rule violations and complete member-hash manifest.
falsifier: Input hash mismatch, changed control member, forbidden source or executable, invalid archive path, size violation or package error.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Single deterministic local package build from frozen inputs.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU packaging operation, 180-second limit; no evaluation cell, site upload, model confirmation or official submission.
